label: Bible Study
prompt: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be _____; I will make him an help meet for him.
verse: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
note: The first 'not good' in the Bible — after six days of 'good,' solitude is the one thing God corrects.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The LORD _____.
verse: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.
note: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice — sung the day the ark came to Jerusalem.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard _____.
verse: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.
note: The queen of Sheba came to test Solomon with hard questions — and by the end 'there was no more spirit in her.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into _____; but is passed from death unto life.
verse: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
note: Note the tenses: the believer already 'hath' everlasting life and 'is passed' from death — verdict settled.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and _____, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
verse: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
note: The great supper's last invitation: go out to the highways and 'hedges' — anywhere — and fill the house.
